svg.title: Modernist typewriter — Figma-editable hybrid, exact-angle visual
svg.desc: 2048x682 transparent image. Layer 01 contains the high-resolution raster horizontal platen, ruler, side knobs and return lever. Layer 02 contains 45 individually editable native SVG radial typebars plus native gradient vector centerpiece/typehead. Optional Layer 03 is a visible photographic bitmap texture overlay for the fan and center: hide this layer to directly edit the underlying SVG shapes. No bitmap-only SVG substitution; editable paths are real vector paths. No drop-shadow or backdrop.

g.aria-label: Editable mechanical vectors: fan, center carriage and typehead
Optional raster surface texture for fan and central carriage
